verdict:
A week later and the fleet still reads like a junk drawer sorted by a man who hates drawers. The summaries say the same thing they said last time: the intern keeps solving one idea in a new repo instead of finishing it in the old one. Four repos now chase the same song-versus-microphone trick, the synth shelf grew another pedal and a talk box, the agent test bed spawned yet another vault and sandbox, and the daily miles feature landed in the field log as a patch file before it landed as code. This is a legislature that passes a new committee every time an old one fails to deliver.

Merge these: scope-listener, phasewell-scope, and song-offset-listener into one listener app with a mode switch. synth, axiom, tinewood-keys, ether-wand, and bitfield-synth into one instrument with a tab bar. looper, tapperator, stompbox-lab, and hoofer-sync into one band room app, since they all share a phone sync room. sound-bender, tickle-boxie, charley-douglass, and fatty-fart-pedal into one sound toy. RTSS, ghost-kitchen-builder, restack, and cross-venue-equivalence-engine into one restaurant survey tool. topo-war and topo-wars, tower2 and tower-builder, topdown-pixeltown and topdown-pixeltowns, and the two pajamastan invoice and warrants pages each into one repo. field-twin, chassisquiver, field-twin-violet-api, and field-twin-viridian share one sign in, so share one codebase too.

Kill or finish these: drivethru-sim, which has no commits at all, plus choreography-synchronizer and xxxx, which have no description and no excuse. x, rat, and skwiggle-v105 look abandoned. skwiggle-mint-pin and skwiggle-backend need a decision. purple-vault, blue-agent-sandbox, doctrine-duel-qx-sandbox, and 2026-10-22-orange-agent are scaffolding around an experiment, so finish the experiment or delete the scaffolding. control-troll and heckle-troll are fine, but sudosilo needs a real profile page.

Keep and polish these: field-twin, which is the one app with real users and real mileage. groundcore and mission-operator, which are one of a kind and quiet. mohavetech-website as the single front door once the clones are gone. mill-ionaire, welcome-to-the-madness, and 2026-10-23-orange-smash, which are alive and changing daily, though they need their stray CSS patches under control. The access terminal apps stay separate on purpose, so leave them alone.
